description: This file defines a set of data structures and functions for representing and manipulating Go types, packages, and symbols, primarily used for code generation or analysis within the Kubernetes project.

classes.name: Name
classes.description: Represents a type or package name, possibly qualified with a package path.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a Go type, including its name, kind, members, methods, and other metadata.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a struct member with name, type, and tags.

classes.name: ParamResult
classes.description: Represents a parameter or result in a function signature.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a function or method signature, including receiver, parameters, and results.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Holds package-level information, including types, functions, variables, constants, and imports.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the type's name.

methods.name: IsPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if the type is a built-in or alias to a built-in type.

methods.name: IsAssignable
methods.description: Checks if the type can be deep-assigned.

methods.name: IsAnonymousStruct
methods.description: Checks if the type is an anonymous struct or alias to one.

methods.name: IsComparable
methods.description: Checks if the type is comparable.
